cases.question: Show me all active surrogates in Screening and list their current substage.

questions.question: For each active surrogate in Screening, how should I identify the “current substage”?
options: List every unfinished Screening substage for each case (some cases may have more than one).
List only the unfinished Screening substage with the highest workflow order for each case; show blank if all are complete.

cases.question: Which IP cases are in matching right now? Include the names and emails for both IPs.
cases.title: IP cases currently in matching
cases.sql: SELECT ic.case_id AS `Case ID`, COALESCE(ic.case_file_name, CONCAT('IP case ', ic.case_id)) AS `Case name`, CONCAT_WS(' ', c1.first_name, c1.last_name) AS `IP 1 name`, c1.email AS `IP 1 email`, CONCAT_WS(' ', c2.first_name, c2.last_name) AS `IP 2 name`, c2.email AS `IP 2 email` FROM ip_case ic JOIN family f ON f.family_id = ic.family_id LEFT JOIN contact c1 ON c1.contact_id = f.ip_1_id LEFT JOIN contact c2 ON c2.contact_id = f.ip_2_id WHERE ic.stage = 'matching' AND ic.active = 1 ORDER BY ic.case_file_name, ic.case_id
assumptions: “In matching right now” means active IP cases whose current workflow stage is matching.
IP names and email addresses come from the two contact records linked to each family; a blank second-IP entry means no second IP contact is recorded.
